categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited operates primarily in copper and gold mining, smelting, and processing, including extraction and processing of rare and scattered metals, sulfur chemical products, and trading. The company has a complete industrial chain covering exploration, mining, beneficiation, smelting, and processing, producing over 50 products such as cathode copper, gold, silver, sulfuric acid, copper rods, tubes, and foils.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company mainly uses pyrometallurgical (fire refining) methods for copper smelting and hydrometallurgical (wet refining) methods for gold extraction. It employs advanced technologies such as flash smelting, oxygen bottom-blown smelting, and intelligent mining systems including international mining design software and Beidou positioning for truck dispatch. The company also invests in digital transformation and industrial internet applications to enhance production efficiency and environmental performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include copper processing enterprises, electronics, electrical, light industry, machinery manufacturing, construction, transportation, and defense sectors. Major markets are domestic regions such as East China, South China, North China, and international markets including South Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and Hong Kong. The company also sells gold primarily through the Shanghai Gold Exchange and silver to domestic industrial users and exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant assets and operations in Jiangxi Province and other provinces such as Shandong and Guangdong. It has overseas investments and projects in Kazakhstan, Mexico, Africa, Canada, Peru, Zambia, Albania, and Tajikistan, with overseas assets accounting for about 17.4% of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Copper is an integrated player operating across the entire supply chain from upstream mining and beneficiation to midstream smelting and refining, and downstream copper processing and product manufacturing. It controls key upstream resources and downstream processing facilities, positioning itself as a fully integrated copper and precious metals producer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development, innovation-driven growth, and digital transformation. R&D focuses on resource utilization of low-grade ores, green beneficiation reagents, extraction and high-value utilization of rare metals, and digital mining and smelting technologies. It collaborates with top universities and research institutes to build an advanced innovation ecosystem and emphasizes sustainable and green development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of copper cathodes, gold, silver, sulfuric acid, and copper processing products. Sales are conducted via direct sales, long-term contracts, spot and futures trading on exchanges such as the Shanghai Futures Exchange and the London Metal Exchange, and government-regulated gold trading platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangxi Copper is the largest copper producer in China and a leading integrated copper and precious metals company with a strong resource base and advanced technology. It holds a dominant position in the domestic market with registered brands on international exchanges. Competitors include other large domestic and international copper producers and refiners, with industry consolidation expected due to cost pressures and market competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 520.9 billion, a slight decrease of 0.18% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 6.96 billion, a 7.03% increase. Total assets reached RMB 193.1 billion, growing 14.85%, and net assets increased 15.61% to RMB 77.9 billion. The company maintains stable production growth and strong financial fundamentals with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi Copper offers a comprehensive, integrated supply chain with scale advantages, advanced smelting and mining technologies, and cost leadership through large-scale operations like the world's largest single copper smelting plant. Its products are internationally recognized with registered brands on LME and LBMA, ensuring quality and reliability. The company emphasizes innovation, green development, and digital transformation to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and environmental sustainability.
